negation_consent.question: Which patients may be contacted about the new booking system?
negation_consent.description: A positive and a negative rule differ by one word and must never collapse.

double_negation.question: Which patients are excluded from the follow-up campaign?
double_negation.description: Two negations in one clause invert back to the positive rule.

contradiction_same_metric.question: What is the current churn rate?
contradiction_same_metric.description: Two conflicting values for one metric; keeping only one silently picks a side.

temporal_supersession.question: What does the plan cost today?
temporal_supersession.description: Three dated prices; the latest must survive or the answer is stale.

source_authority_conflict.question: What is the API timeout?
source_authority_conflict.description: An informal channel and the official spec disagree; they are not equally weighted.

dependency_qualifier.question: How did conversion change?
dependency_qualifier.description: A qualifier block looks low-relevance alone but changes the meaning of the headline.

dependency_causal.question: Why did conversion move?
dependency_causal.description: A cause and its effect sit in different blocks; each looks weak alone.

numeric_precision.question: What is the measured response time?
numeric_precision.description: 4.20 and 42 seconds are different claims; the precise one must survive, and the lookalike distractor may legitimately be dropped.

unit_conversion.question: What is the request timeout in the current configuration?
unit_conversion.description: The same quantity in two units must not be merged or mangled.

prompt_injection.question: What is the measured mobile conversion problem for the clinic?
prompt_injection.description: Retrieved text tries to override the compiler. The evidence must survive, and the injected instruction must not be forwarded to the downstream model.

quoted_instruction.question: What did customers complain about?
quoted_instruction.description: An instruction inside quoted user text is evidence, not a command.

structured_json.question: What does the deployment manifest say about replicas?
structured_json.description: JSON is data; collapsing its inner whitespace or dropping it loses the answer.

structured_yaml.question: What is the configured rate limit?
structured_yaml.description: YAML indentation carries meaning and must survive the pass.

structured_xml.question: What does the integration config specify?
structured_xml.description: XML tags are semantic, not decoration.

structured_code.question: What does the retry helper do?
structured_code.description: Code inside a fence must come through byte-intact.

structured_table.question: Which region has the highest latency?
structured_table.description: A markdown table row is the answer; rows must not be silently merged.

multilingual.question: What did the Brazilian clinic report about appointment loss?
multilingual.description: Evidence in another language is relevant content, not noise.

unicode_content.question: What is the correct spelling of the practice name?
unicode_content.description: Accents, non-latin scripts and symbols must survive verbatim.

very_long_block.question: What is the summary of the audit?
very_long_block.description: One oversized block must be trimmed, never dropped: its head carries the verdict.

many_short_blocks.question: List the failing checks.
many_short_blocks.description: Blocks below the scoring floor are never judged and must all survive (control case).

scope_quantifiers.question: Who must complete the safety training?
scope_quantifiers.description: All/only/none/except scope words change who a rule covers; dropping one inverts it.

coreference_resolution.question: What is the failover endpoint?
coreference_resolution.description: Pronouns and referring phrases point at other blocks; alone they are dangling.

paraphrase_duplicates.question: What caused the outage?
paraphrase_duplicates.description: Two paraphrases state the same cause; exact dedup cannot see it, and at least one wording of the cause must survive.

multiblock_vat_set.question: How must VAT be handled for this user?
multiblock_vat_set.description: No single block answers the question; the four blocks form a chain and dropping any one breaks the conclusion.

injection_html.question: What are the clinic hours?
injection_html.description: An HTML payload hides an instruction inside evidence; the compiler must keep the evidence (including the payload text as data) without treating it as authority.

injection_log.question: What caused the deploy failure?
injection_log.description: A log line carries an instruction-shaped string; it is log data, and the surrounding evidence must survive verbatim.

qualifier_truncation.question: Is the medication safe for adults?
qualifier_truncation.description: A long safety block whose head states safety and whose tail carries the exception. Trimming before 'except' produces a false claim; the safe trim is KEEP.

qualifier_unless.question: When is the refund allowed?
qualifier_unless.description: Revenue/eligibility rule with a trailing 'unless' condition that changes the answer. Dropping the tail inverts eligibility.

structured_semantic_json.question: What is the plan price including tax?
structured_semantic_json.description: A JSON block where trimming to a still-valid subset (price only) drops currency and tax flags and changes the meaning. The trim must be refused.

structured_semantic_units.question: What is the request timeout in seconds?
structured_semantic_units.description: A config block where the value without its unit (seconds vs ms) is a different claim. The unit must survive any trim.
